params.body:
## Why

On the vehicle sheet the AI description block showed a bare, browser-blue checkbox next to
"Voor deze wagen toch ook de beschrijving eigen wagenpark schrijven". It was not alone:
`.ui-checkbox` was a class **views already used and `refresh.css` never defined** (it sat on the
exemption list in `StylesheetSyntaxTest`), so roughly forty checkboxes across the sheet, the
stocklist filters and the settings screens rendered as native boxes on screens that are otherwise
in the house style.

Five more things turned up in the same block while fixing it, each a small commit of its own.

## The component

A checkbox is a **choice you tick**; `x-ui.switch` stays a **state you turn on or off**. Both post
the same way, they differ in what is being asked — rendering the second as a track made the AI
modal read as a setting that had already taken effect. Switches are untouched.

- `.ui-checkbox` — an 18px square, brand colour when ticked, a visible focus ring, a disabled
  state. Same square the filter column already drew in `.ui-check`, pulled out so every screen
  can use it.
- `.ui-checkbox-row` — the wrapping label. `align-items: flex-start` plus a millimetre of top
  margin keeps the box on the **first line** of a label that wraps, instead of floating between
  two lines.
- `x-ui.checkbox` gained `label`, `id`, `disabled`, `hidden` (the 0 companion, off by default) and
  `bare`. Everything else — `wire:model`, `x-model`, `onchange`, `data-*`, an extra class — still
  rides through `$attributes` onto the input.
- `'ui-checkbox'` is off the exemption list in `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, now that it is defined.

**The wand on "Beschrijving schrijven met AI".** Not a purge and not a dropped `<i>`: the glyph was
always in the DOM and Font Awesome still ships `fa-magic` (the same icon is visible in the modal
title). `.ui-ai-icon` carried its own `var(--brand-blue)` from the days the button was a pale
`.btn-info`; once the button became `.ui-button--primary` that blue **is** the background, so the
icon was painted in the button's own colour and vanished without leaving a gap. Fixed at the class
level: `.ui-button i, .ui-button svg { color: inherit }`, so no icon in any house button can
disappear this way again. The accent stays on the light ground of the modal title.

## What was converted

| Screen | What |
|---|---|
| Vehicle sheet, AI modal | the "write the own-stock text too" choice → `x-ui.checkbox` (id `ai_include_own` kept; `structurize.js` reads `:checked` **and** `.length`) |
| Vehicle sheet, tab Data | 7 inputs carrying `icheckbox_flat-blue` — a skin with no CSS and no script behind it — → `.ui-checkbox` |
| Vehicle sheet, Livewire | the ~10 inputs that already said `class="ui-checkbox"` now actually get styling; no blade change |
| Vehicle sheet, options + extra options | `.ui-checkbox`, and the dead `form-control-sm icheckbox_flat-blue` dropped (`option_input`, a real hook, kept) |
| Stocklist filter + extended search | same |
| Settings › settings CRUD | `x-ui.checkbox` default |

## What was left (deliberately)

- **Row selection in a list** (`_wagen_rij`, transport) — PR 282 styled these; `bare`.
- **The rights matrix** (`settings/access/edit`, `child`) — hangs on the theme's
  `.checkbox-primary`, which styles the *sibling* label; ours would draw a second box. `bare`.
- **Photo selection overlays** (`photos/image`, `sl_image`) — their own styling on top of an image.
- **The public website tabs** and the **simple CRUD** screens — not in the house style yet.
- **Switches.** Most `type="checkbox"` hits under `resources/views/**` are Bootstrap
  `custom-control-input switch` toggles (settings, dealer, stocklist filters, portals on the
  classic sheet). Those are switches, not checkboxes, and stay.
- **`_tabs/prices.blade.php`** — another agent is in that file; the remaining screen for the
  title style.
- **Option group headings** in `_tabs/options.blade.php` — sub-headings inside a tab, not
  sections; making each one a dashed section title is a judgement call, not a cleanup.

## Also in this branch

**The descriptions grow after the AI fills them.** PR 271 assumed the native `input` event
`structurize.js` dispatches was enough. It is — until Livewire re-renders the textarea a moment
later: the server knows no height, so the morph strips the inline height and the text lands in a
small box with an inner scrollbar. `check()` then read that empty height as "the user dragged the
corner" and locked the field for good. The field now has a named hook, `ui-autogrow`, which
re-runs the **same** `grow()` — now, and once more after the round trip. Measured at 1280×900:

| | height | content | cut off |
|---|---|---|---|
| before | 146px | 1656px | yes |
| after | **540px** = exactly the 60vh ceiling | 1656px | yes, at the ceiling, as designed |

A real drag still wins: dragging to 140px and letting go keeps 140px through a later fill.

**WebP uploads.** Added `image/webp` to the car and damage uploaders, to `SlUpload`'s default, and
to the list of types the client-side resize handles — without that last one a webp would have been
accepted but uploaded at full size. Nothing blocked it server-side: `upload_dropzone` does no mime
validation and `ProcessVehiclePhoto` uses `Image::make` + `encode(null, 85)`, which keeps the type.
A resized webp arrives as jpeg (the canvas always gives jpeg); one under the limit arrives as webp
and is processed the same way. The "only JPG or PNG" message now says WebP too, in all five
languages. The dealer logo input has no `accept` at all and the remove.bg background uses
`image/*`, so both already took webp — nothing to align.

> **HEIC, asked and answered: no, nowhere.** Zero hits for heic/heif in `resources/`, `app/` or
> `config/`. A dealer uploading straight from an iPhone set to "High Efficiency" hits a wall with
> "Alleen JPG, PNG of WebP" unless iOS converts on pick. Not added here on purpose: the browser
> cannot decode it for the resize, so it needs server-side conversion.

**Sheet sections.** Showroom leaves Algemeen and sits next to Website with a heading of its own and
a muted `ui-field-help` line in five languages. `tabForField()` said `general` for
`showroom_vehicle` while the field renders under Data, so an error on it sent the user to a step
without the field; corrected. (`on_website` has the same skew, deliberately left.) "Schadevoertuig"
moves under the Portals heading as the first item of that block — it stood *above* it and read as a
website setting. Portals get their mark: the favicon-or-monogram logic was inline `@php` on the
classic sheet only, which is why the Livewire sheet listed them as plain text; it is now
`x-ui.portal-icon`, used by both. And the Livewire sheet's four plain bold `h5` now use the
existing `.ui-edit .card-title` (blue dash, small caps) like the rest of the sheet.

> **Portal icons still needed.** A logo is a trademark and the build has no network, so nothing was
> invented or downloaded. `public/img/portals/` holds **touringcarselect.png** and **okasie.png**.
> Still on the monogram, and needing a real square favicon from Shane:
> **Gocar, 2dehands, Cartel, Facebook Business, Flexlease, goforlease.com**, and any other portal a
> dealer has enabled. One file each: `public/img/portals/<portal code>.png`.

## Screenshots

Rendered from the compiled component output against the built `refresh.css` of this branch and of
`origin/main`, at 1280 and 390.

- `checkbox-before-1280.png` / `checkbox-after-1280.png` (and `-390`) — the AI block and the modal
  choice, the Data tab, an option list. The before shot shows both bugs at once: the button reads
  as text only, and every box is browser-blue.
- `checkbox-sections-before-1280.png` / `checkbox-sections-after-1280.png` (and `-390`) — Stocklist,
  Showroom, Website and Portals with the unified title, the showroom help line, Schadevoertuig in
  its new place, and the portal marks.
- `aigrow-before-1280.png` / `aigrow-after-1280.png` — the two descriptions after an AI fill
  followed by a Livewire re-render.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` (416 views) + `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: clean. `public/build` is untracked and not committed.
- `php artisan test --filter='SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|Vehicle|VehicleForm|Settings'`
  → **250 passed**, 1 skipped.
- Full suite → 549 tests, 1 failure: `BuildStampTest` (`/.well-known/build.json` 404). It fails the
  same way on a clean `origin/main` in this worktree, so it is an artefact of the isolated
  checkout, not of this branch.
- Own MySQL database, loaded from `database/schema/mysql-schema.sql` plus the post-2026-07-28
  migrations the way CI does, DB settings passed as command-line env vars, dropped afterwards. No
  `.env` file was read or written.
- Every id and class touched was grepped in `resources/js/**` first: `ai_include_own`
  (`structurize.js`), `option_input` (`edit`/`create` change handlers), `icheckbox_flat-blue`
  (no CSS, no script — dead), `lw_portal_*`, `lw_accident`, `lw_showroom`. Names, values,
  `wire:model`, handlers, the hidden 0 companions and the POST are unchanged throughout.
params.title: Checkboxes in the house style
